title: Focused historical health vector follow-up
scope: 11 assigned raster-only historical health bodies; original-native vector search, no tracing or substituted successor artwork.
method: Whole-file PyMuPDF get_drawings/get_image_info object inventory; full-size covers and contact sheets of every page with drawing paths visually examined. No claim of page-by-page visual review of all 297 pages. Native shapes for charts, tables, cover lettering, and tiny OCR bullet/spot shapes were not accepted as agency vector logos.
limits: The first five fresh original-source retrievals failed with 403, 429, timeout or 503; failures are not proof of missing archive content.
No further Wayback requests were made after 429 responses.
Searches often returned old corpus entries or successor identities; no global absence claim.
Existing similar names were not merged or reassigned. No verified false gap found among these eleven bodies.
